answer_1.quote: We build a comprehensive evaluation suite of 13 benchmarks, spanning pairwise, single rating, and classification tasks and various domains (e.g., safety, summarization)...
answer_1.outputs: Free‑text critiques and final judgments (e.g., scores, pairwise selections, classifications) of model responses

answer_2.quote: For pairwise comparison benchmarks, we report the agreement between judges and human annotators (i.e., accuracy), and for single rating benchmarks, we report Pearson correlation coefficient between judge and human ratings.

answer_3.quote: LLM-as-judge ... both assess and critique outputs from other models ... We train our judges to perform four evaluation tasks: Single‑instance rating, pairwise comparison, binary classification, and response deduction.

answer_4.quote: We evaluate each judge baseline only on the evaluation task(s) it is trained to perform... For pairwise comparison and classification benchmarks, we report the agreement between judges and human annotators (i.e., accuracy)... For single rating benchmarks, we report Pearson correlation coefficient between judge and human ratings.
answer_4.guideline: Select the best response (or provide a rating/classification) based on criteria such as helpfulness, accuracy, level of detail, and harmlessness.
